environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW route). Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint policy restricts the principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/PreferenceSyncServiceRole and the endpoint's security group only permits inbound TCP/443 from the CIDR 10.0.48.0/20 (the preference-sync service subnet). There is no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering or transit gateway attachment that routes to any non-RFC1918 address space. The NLB target group performs TLS termination with mutual TLS (mTLS) requiring a client certificate issued by the internal ACM PCA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:111122223333:certificate-authority/abc12345-def6-7890-ghij-klmnopqrstuv).

config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, no public route
config.mtls: Required, client cert from internal ACM PCA
config.internet_access: None (no IGW, no NAT, no TGW public route)
